name: Media Manager
author: vinicgobbi
description: MPRIS media control: left click opens the popup, right click plays/pauses

barWidget.description: MPRIS now-playing: left click opens the popup, right click plays/pauses

schema.label: Album cover
schema.description: A small picture before the text.

schema.label: Player name
schema.description: The app playing, like Spotify or Chrome.

schema.label: Elapsed time
schema.description: Position in the track, when the player reports it.

schema.label: Hide when paused
schema.description: The widget disappears while nothing is playing.

schema.label: Fit the text
schema.description: Show the whole text and grow or shrink the widget with it. When off, the widget keeps a fixed width.

schema.label: Long text
schema.description: Only used with a fixed width: scroll the text or cut it with "...".

schema.label: Width (px)
schema.description: Only used with a fixed width.

schema.label: Character limit
schema.description: Only used with a fixed width and "ellipsis".
